title: CAN FD Configuration
text: Configure parameters for specified CAN FD device; {Device} sets the cAN device and channel, {Arbitration Bus speed} sets the arbitration bit rate numeric, {Data Bus speed} sets the data bit rate numeric, {Bus frequency} sets the pEAK-System bus rate numeric, {Arbitration/Data bit rate prescaler} sets the bit rate prescaler integer, {Synchronization jump width} sets the maximum allowed time, {Time segment 1} sets the number of time quanta before sample, {Time segment 2} sets the number of time quanta after, {Verify bit parameter settings validity} sets the check validity of settings and {Acknowledge mode} controls channel activity on CAN. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Device
params.values: CAN device and channel list option

params.name: Time segment 1
params.values: Number of time quanta before sample integer

params.name: Time segment 2
params.values: Number of time quanta after sample integer

params.name: Acknowledge mode
params.values: Control channel activity on CAN bus Normal (default) | Silent
